other formal: datatype 'a tree = Leaf | Node "'a tree" 'a "'a tree"

formal function definitions.subtrees:
fun subtrees :: "'a tree \<Rightarrow> 'a tree set" where
  "subtrees Leaf = {Leaf}" |
  "subtrees (Node l a r) = {Node l a r} \<union> subtrees l \<union> subtrees r"
formal function definitions.size:
primrec size :: "'a tree \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "size Leaf = 0" |
  "size (Node l x r) = size l + size r + 1"

formal theorem statement: theorem size_subtrees: "s \<in> subtrees t \<Longrightarrow> size s \<le> size t"
